newsitem.title: USA: First Bank to buy bond indenture business.
newsitem.headline: First Bank to buy bond indenture business.

text.p: First Bank Systems Inc said Thursday it would acquire the bond indenture services and paying agency business of Detroit-based Comerica Inc.
The acquired business, which will become part of First Bank's corporate trust operation, provides these services for about 860 municipal and corporate clients with about 2,400 bond issues.
First Bank already has about 8,750 clients with almost 27,500 bond issues. A spokeswoman said the bank holding company does not publicly break out the revenue generated from the business.
